summary: Shapes 1, 9, 10 and 11 are the same 7.52 GFLOP problem at 1, 2, 4 and 16 heads. Our candidate is flat within 3.5 percent from one to four heads at 0.5601, 0.5509 and 0.5704 ms, then jumps to 0.9175 ms at sixteen heads, a 63.7 percent penalty on identical arithmetic. A torch-profiler diagnostic on identical bytes localised the entire penalty to the K2 fused attention kernel, which runs 2.13 times slower while K1, the final norm and the device copies are all flat within 4 percent, and K2 achieved throughput falls from 14.5 TF per second at head dim 32 to 8.5 at head dim 8. That penalty has two parts. The arithmetic part is irreducible in Triton because hd_pad is max of 16 and next power of two of head dim, so both attention matmuls run at half useful width when head dim is 8, raising K2 work by about 25 percent. The efficiency part is not irreducible: K2 time rises 113 percent, far more than the 25 percent of extra work, and the residue is tiling and occupancy because at sixteen heads the kernel runs sixteen sequential head iterations each holding a full fp32 accumulator. The k009 config list was written for the four-head shapes and offers the tuner nothing below two warps, nothing above BLOCK_N 64, and no pipelining depth at all.
